candidates.change_summary: Delete the withdraw(address(this).balance) call so withdrawAll transfers nothing.
Replace the withdrawn amount with depositsCount so the transfer amount (or revert) differs from transferring the full balance.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any caller can withdraw the contract balance.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners (callers other than owner) pass the modifier.
Delete the require statement so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access.
Invert the ownership check to require msg.sender != owner.
Replace transfer with a low-level call so failure is not reverted and gas forwarding differs.
Withdraw the entire contract balance instead of the requested _value.
Delete the call statement so sendMoney no longer transfers any ether.
Replace _value with 0 in the call so no value is ever sent.
Replace _target with msg.sender so the funds are sent back to the caller instead of the target.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so anyone may call it.
Invert the require condition in the onlyOwner modifier so it only allows non-owners.
